editorial:
Imagine being born old and growing younger. Benjamin Button starts life as an elderly man in a New Orleans nursing home, then meets Daisy as a child. Their paths cross over the course of his life, and the movie follows his strange adventures while always circling back to their love story. It really feels like a big, emotional romance with a fantasy twist, full of longing and missed timing.

The acting is really strong, especially Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett, and the movie looks very beautiful from start to finish. The pacing is slow, but it gives the story room to breathe. The downside is the long runtime and a few stretches that drag. If you enjoy epic love stories with a unique idea, this is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or watch it on 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Benjamin becomes a child and loses his memories. Daisy cares for him as he ages backward into a baby, then he dies in her arms. Daisy later tells the whole story to her daughter while Hurricane Katrina floods the nursing home. The twist is that their love finally comes together only when time has almost run out.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves epic love stories with a unique fantasy twist.
